Plans per day by instance (contract §2.F)
panels.description: Daily plan_journal write count split by planner_instance audit label. Bars stack to show total throughput; labels are historical audit metadata under Hermes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
       COALESCE(planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       count(*)::int AS plans
  FROM plan_journal
 WHERE created_at > $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1, 2

panels.description: Count of planner_trigger_log rows that transitioned to status='timed_out' in the panel time range. Sparkline shows daily trend. Big number = today's count only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', delivered_at) AS time,
       count(*)::int AS "Timed out"
  FROM plan_delivery_log
 WHERE status = 'timed_out'
   AND delivered_at > $__timeFrom() AND delivered_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Plan-write latency by instance (trigger_id join)
panels.description: Distribution of seconds between plan_delivery_log.delivered_at and the matching plan_journal.created_at, one series per planner_instance audit label. Tail on the right = slow cycles. Bucketed at 5-second resolution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(pj.planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pj.created_at - ptl.delivered_at)::float AS latency_seconds
  FROM plan_journal pj
  JOIN plan_delivery_log ptl ON ptl.trigger_id = pj.trigger_id
 WHERE pj.created_at > $__timeFrom() AND pj.created_at < $__timeTo()
   AND pj.created_at >= ptl.delivered_at
 ORDER BY 2

options.content:
### Controlled experiment — blinded ops board (#587, audit §8.7/§8.10)

Live panels for the controlled planner experiment (migrations 207–210: `control_experiments`, `control_assignments`, `policy_delivery_outbox`, `policy_device_snapshots`, `policy_exposures`, `experiment_events`).

**Blinded fields ONLY (visible during the run):**
- opaque assignment id (UUID, no treatment meaning)
- activation receipt (staged/activated times, device-echoed confirmation)
- expected-vs-confirmed identity equality (boolean only — never the hashes)
- exposure coverage fraction + close/fallback reason
- delivery lag (outbox enqueue → device activation)
- safety/fallback + protocol-deviation events (kind/severity/actor only)
- active experiment lifecycle state (kind/status — public GitOps facts)

**NEVER on this board while an experiment runs:** treatment labels or the X/Y→A/B mapping, template content hashes, component values, proposal source, or any efficacy/outcome metric. The outcome-analysis role is blinded by construction (§8.7); this board must not leak what the database refuses. Verified by tests/test_experiment_verify.py.

panels.title: Exposure coverage (7d)
panels.description: Fraction of the trailing 7 days covered by identity-confirmed exposure intervals (policy_exposures, clipped to the window). Blinded: coverage only — no treatment labels, no content identity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(COALESCE(ended_at, now()), now()) - GREATEST(started_at, now() - interval '7 days')))) / (7 * 86400.0), 0) AS coverage
FROM policy_exposures
WHERE identity_confirmed
  AND COALESCE(ended_at, now()) > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: Expected = confirmed (24h)
panels.description: BOOL_AND over exposures updated in the last 24h with a device-observed activation identity: does the device-echoed identity equal the expected one? Blinded: the equality boolean only — the hashes themselves NEVER render here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT BOOL_AND(observed_activation_sha256 = expected_activation_sha256) AS identity_ok
FROM policy_exposures
WHERE observed_activation_sha256 IS NOT NULL
  AND updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Assignment receipts (opaque)
panels.description: Latest delivery receipt + exposure state per assignment: opaque UUID, staged/activated times, enqueue→activation lag, identity-confirmed flag, coverage, close/fallback reason. Blinded: no treatment labels, no X/Y→A/B resolution, no content hashes, no component values.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.assignment_id,
       lower(a.valid_range) AS starts_at,
       o.staged_at,
       o.activated_at,
       o.activated_at - o.created_at AS delivery_lag,
       e.identity_confirmed,
       e.coverage_fraction,
       e.close_reason
FROM control_assignments a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ob.staged_at, ob.activated_at, ob.created_at
  FROM policy_delivery_outbox ob
  JOIN effective_policy_vectors v ON v.vector_id = ob.vector_id
  WHERE v.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
  ORDER BY ob.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) o ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ex.identity_confirmed, ex.coverage_fraction, ex.close_reason
  FROM policy_exposures ex
  WHERE ex.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
  ORDER BY ex.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
) e ON true
ORDER BY lower(a.valid_range) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Delivery outbox (24h)
panels.description: Outbox health: vector transactions in flight, failed, max attempt count and median enqueue→activation lag. Blinded: counts and timing only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state NOT IN ('activated', 'abandoned')) AS in_flight,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed') AS failed,
       COALESCE(max(attempt_count), 0) AS max_attempts,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY activated_at - created_at)) AS median_lag_s
FROM policy_delivery_outbox
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Safety / protocol events (7d)
panels.description: experiment_events with warning/critical severity or deviation/override/emergency kind. Kind, severity, actor and time only — the detail payload is deliberately NOT rendered (it may carry identifying lineage).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT recorded_at, event_kind, severity, actor
FROM experiment_events
WHERE recorded_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  AND (severity <> 'info' OR event_kind IN ('protocol_deviation', 'override', 'emergency_action'))
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 30;

panels.title: Active experiment
panels.description: Lifecycle state of the at-most-one armed/running/paused experiment (kind/status/timezone are public GitOps facts; no treatment information).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind, status, timezone, started_at
FROM control_experiments
WHERE status IN ('armed', 'running', 'paused')
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
